description: Convert paper sizes. Pass `size` by name (A0 to A10, B0 to B10, C0 to C10, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, Ledger, Executive, Statement, Junior Legal, ANSI C/D/E, Arch A to E, DL, US and EU business cards) or pass custom `width` and `height` with `unit` (mm, cm, in, pt). Returns millimetres, inches, points (1/72 in), pixels at 72, 96 and 300 ppi, aspect ratio, area, the nearest standard sizes with the difference, and the ISO relationships (A series halves the long side; B is the geometric mean of A neighbours; C is the geometric mean of A and B). ISO values are the published whole-millimetre figures.

size.description: Standard name, e.g. A4, Letter, B5, C6
